name: Toolbox
description: XP and daily stats. XP: session time, adventurer and producer pools, XP earned in the last hour; hover for XP Detailed with levels, progress bars, XP per hour and time to next level. Today: gold picked up, kills and XP since midnight; hover for every item gained today, with optional estimated values from shroudoftheavatar.net (uses the internet, off by default). Health & focus bars. Combat stats HUD: DPS, damage taken, healing, crit and avoid rates. Buff bar: your buffs and debuffs with a clock sweep, and optional sound alerts before a buff runs out and when a debuff lands. Commands: /toolbox and /tbx.
author: shawn butts
